items.source: Allows for programmatic management of JDBC Savepoints. Spring's DefaultTransactionStatus automatically delegates to this, as it autodetects transaction objects which implement the SavepointManager interface.
items.translation: 支持对 JDBC Savepoints 进行程序化管理。Spring 的 DefaultTransactionStatus 会自动委托给此功能，因为它能够自动检测实现 SavepointManager 接口的事务对象。

items.source: Set the read-only status of this transaction. The default is false.
items.translation: 设置此事务的只读状态。默认值为false。

items.source: Set whether savepoints are allowed within this transaction. The default is false.
items.translation: 设置是否允许在此事务中使用保存点。默认值为false。

items.source: This implementation creates a JDBC Savepoint and returns it.
items.translation: 此实现会创建一个 JDBC 保存点并返回它。

items.source: Return the ConnectionHolder for this transaction object.
items.translation: 返回此事务对象的 ConnectionHolder。

items.source: Return the retained previous isolation level, if any.
items.translation: 返回保留的先前隔离级别（如果有）。

items.source: Check whether this transaction object has a ConnectionHolder.
items.translation: 检查此事务对象是否具有 ConnectionHolder。

items.source: Return the read-only status of this transaction.
items.translation: 返回此事务的只读状态。

items.source: Return whether savepoints are allowed within this transaction.
items.translation: 返回是否允许在当前事务中使用保存点。

items.source: This implementation releases the given JDBC Savepoint.
items.translation: 此实现会释放给定的 JDBC 保存点。

items.source: This implementation rolls back to the given JDBC Savepoint.
items.translation: 此实现回滚到给定的 JDBC 保存点。

items.source: Set the ConnectionHolder for this transaction object.
items.translation: 为此事务对象设置 ConnectionHolder。

items.source: Set the previous isolation level to retain, if any.
items.translation: 将之前的隔离级别设置为保留（如果有的话）。

items.translation: TransactionException - 如果无法创建保存点，例如因为事务未处于适当状态。

items.source: TransactionException - if the rollback failed
items.translation: TransactionException - 如果回滚失败

items.source: TransactionException - if the release failed
items.translation: TransactionException - 如果释放失败
